Your inDrive rides just got more rewarding with Khalti × inDrive Fuel On Us! 

From 25th Bhadra to 25th Mangsir 2083 BS, Khalti and inDrive are rewarding both passengers and drivers for choosing Khalti for their ride payments.

  • For Drivers:  Khalti Garyo, Petrol Paryo! 

What is Fuel On Us? 

Fuel On Us is a three-month Khalti × inDrive campaign where eligible ride payments made through Khalti give passengers and drivers a chance to win daily rewards. Whether you are taking an inDrive ride or driving one, using Khalti can give you a chance to win. 

Khalti Garyo, Free Paryo! 

Heading somewhere with inDrive? Pay your eligible ride fare through Khalti and get a chance to win Rs. 200 Khalti Balance every day. The best part? You don’t need to register separately. 

Simply: 

  1. Book your ride through inDrive. 
  1. Complete your ride. 
  1. Pay your eligible ride fare using Khalti. 
  1. Your payment automatically becomes an entry into the daily lucky draw. 
  1. 10 lucky passengers win Rs. 200 Khalti Balance every day. 

So, next time you take an inDrive ride, remember: 

Are you an inDrive driver? 

Now, getting your ride fares through Khalti can get you closer to a petrol reward. 

Receive at least 5 eligible inDrive ride payments through Khalti in a single day and qualify for that day’s lucky draw. 

How it works 

  1. Drive with inDrive as usual. 
  1. Receive your ride fares through Khalti. 
  1. Receive 5 or more eligible Khalti ride payments in a day. 
  1. Enter the daily lucky draw. 
  1. 10 lucky drivers win 5 litres of petrol worth Rs. 1,000 every day. 

Keep receiving your ride payments through Khalti and get a fresh chance to qualify every day during the campaign.

Driver T&Cs

  1. The campaign is valid from 25th Bhadra to 25th Mangsir 2083.
  2. The offer is applicable to inDrive drivers receiving eligible ride fares through Khalti.
  3. Drivers must receive at least 5 eligible inDrive ride fares through Khalti within a single day to qualify for that day’s lucky draw.
  4. Only successfully completed inDrive rides paid through Khalti will be counted.
  5. Eligible drivers will be automatically entered into the daily lucky draw. No separate registration is required.
  6. 10 lucky drivers will be selected every day, and each winner will receive 5 litres of petrol worth Rs. 1,000.
  7. A driver can qualify for the lucky draw on multiple days during the campaign period.
  8. Cancelled, failed, refunded, reversed, or otherwise ineligible transactions will not be counted.
  9. Winners will be selected through a random lucky draw and announced through Khalti’s official communication channels.
  10. Khalti reserves the right to verify transactions and disqualify participants involved in fraudulent, suspicious, or abusive activity.
  11. Khalti reserves the right to modify, extend, suspend, or terminate the campaign with prior notice.
  12. All decisions made by Khalti regarding the campaign and winner selection shall be considered final.
  13. Other terms and conditions may apply.

 

 Passenger T&Cs

  1. The campaign is valid from 25th Bhadra to 25th Mangsir 2083.
  2. The offer is applicable to inDrive passengers who pay eligible ride fares through Khalti.
  3. Every successfully completed inDrive ride paid through Khalti will automatically qualify the passenger for that day’s lucky draw.
  4. No separate registration or sign-up is required to participate.
  5. 10 lucky passengers will be selected every day, and each winner will receive Rs. 200 Khalti Balance.
  6. A passenger can qualify for the lucky draw through multiple eligible ride payments during the campaign period.
  7. Only successful and eligible ride payments made through Khalti will be considered.
  8. Cancelled, failed, refunded, reversed, or otherwise ineligible transactions will not be counted.
  9. Winners will be selected through a random lucky draw and announced through Khalti’s official communication channels.
  10. Khalti reserves the right to verify transactions and disqualify participants involved in fraudulent, suspicious, or abusive activity.
  11. Khalti reserves the right to modify, extend, suspend, or terminate the campaign with prior notice.
  12. All decisions made by Khalti regarding the campaign and winner selection shall be considered final.
  13. Other terms and conditions may apply.
